- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (positive sentiment > 0.3) — reduce forecast by 1–2% for 3–5 day horizons.
- Underestimate prices after strong negative sentiment spikes (sentiment < -0.5) — add 1–3% to forecast for 10+ day horizons.
- Overshoot after recent price spikes — cap forecast at 10% below peak of prior 3-day window.
- Mean-reversion bias: if forecast > 20% above 30-day moving average, reduce by 10–15% for next 5 days.
- Lagged sentiment effect: if sentiment drops sharply 2–3 days before forecast, adjust forecast down 1–2% for next 7 days.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts tend to overestimate by 2–4% in high volatility periods — apply downward correction if sentiment volatility > 0.8.
